ORCID is a free, unique, persistent identifier (PID) for individuals to use as they engage in research, scholarship, and innovation activities. Learn how ORCID can help you spend more time conducting your research and less time managing it. Learn more about ORCID for Researchers.

Uniquely Yours

Distinguish yourself and claim credit for your work no matter how many people have your same (or similar) name. Sign up here.

Portable profile data

Easily share data between your record and funding, publications, data repositories, and other research workflows.

ORCID allows universities and research institutions to stay up to date with their researchers’ outputs, reduce administrative burden and input errors, and helps their researchers, post-docs, employees, and students improve the discoverability of their work. Learn more about ORCID for Universities and Research Institutions.

Support research productivity

Let your researchers spend more time on their research by reducing administrative burden

Track Careers

Track researchers’ and graduates’ careers after they leave your institution as well as collaborators and peers at other institutions.

Publishers that integrate with ORCID can streamline workflows for authors, editors, and reviewers alike. ORCID improves the overall value of books and journals to the community, helping ensure that publishers have greater retention of authors and readers. Learn more about ORCID for Publishers.

Know your authors

Better know who your authors, co-authors, and reviewers are and improve the integrity of your submission, review, and reporting processes.

FEATURED NEWS

Validated ORCID Data Correlates with Global University Performance

Recent research from SCImago Labs reveals a strong correlation between institution-asserted ORCID data and higher positions in global university rankings.
When ORCID member institutions directly validate researcher affiliations on ORCID records, they add Trust Markers to the digital research ecosystem, making it easier for researchers and institutions to build credibility in research activities across the globe. ORCID members are part of what we call a Community Trust Network and contribute to dramatically improving research visibility, citation accuracy, and administrative efficiency. Strengthen your university’s digital footprint, safeguard research integrity, and showcase your global institutional performance. Assert your researchers’ affiliations with ORCID today.

ORCID is Partnering with the Publishing Community to Credit Peer Review Service

ORCID and leading publishers have launched a pilot automatically adding verified peer review credits to reviewers’ profiles. This initiative standardizes recognition, reduces administrative burdens, and strengthens global research integrity.
